cases.sentence: Волны ___ отхлынули, и на затихшем море образуются круги, по которым носятся дипломаты, воображая, что именно они производят затишье движения.
cases.explain: «большого движения» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The flood of nations begins to subside into its normal channels. The waves of the great movement abate, and on the calm surface eddies are formed in which float the diplomatists, who imagine that they have caused the floods to abate.

cases.sentence: Дипломатам кажется, что они, их несогласия, причиной этого ___ сил; они ждут войны между своими государями; положение им кажется неразрешимым.
cases.explain: «нового напора» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: But the smooth sea again suddenly becomes disturbed. The diplomatists think that their disagreements are the cause of this fresh pressure of natural forces; they anticipate war between their sovereigns; the position seems to them insoluble. But the wave they feel to be rising does not come from the quarter they expect. It rises again from the same point as before—Paris. The last backwash of the movement from the west occurs: a backwash which serves to solve the apparently insuperable diplomatic difficulties and ends the military movement of that period of history.

cases.sentence: Человек этот нужен еще для оправдания последнего ___.
cases.explain: «совокупного действия» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: This man is still needed to justify the final collective act. That act is performed.

cases.sentence: Во время ___ лицо это бездействует, так как оно не нужно.
cases.explain: «народной войны» — after the preposition «во», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: During the national war he was inactive because he was not needed. But as soon as the necessity for a general European war presented itself he appeared in his place at the given moment and, uniting the nations of Europe, led them to the goal.

cases.sentence: Но как скоро является необходимость общей ___, лицо это в данный момент является на свое место, и соединяя европейские народы, ведет их к цели.
cases.explain: «европейской войны» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: During the national war he was inactive because he was not needed. But as soon as the necessity for a general European war presented itself he appeared in his place at the given moment and, uniting the nations of Europe, led them to the goal.

cases.sentence: После ___ 1815 года Александр находится на вершине возможной человеческой власти.
cases.explain: «последней войны» — after the preposition «после», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The goal is reached. After the final war of 1815 Alexander possesses all possible power. How does he use it?

cases.sentence: ___, ближе изучив жизнь роя, говорит, что пчела собирает пыль и сок для выкармливания молодых пчел и выведения матки, что цель ее состоит в продолжении рода.
cases.explain: «Другой пчеловод» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: A bee settling on a flower has stung a child. And the child is afraid of bees and declares that bees exist to sting people. A poet admires the bee sucking from the chalice of a flower and says it exists to suck the fragrance of flowers. A beekeeper, seeing the bee collect pollen from flowers and carry it to the hive, says that it exists to gather honey. Another beekeeper who has studied the life of the hive more closely says that the bee gathers pollen dust to feed the young bees and rear a queen, and that it exists to perpetuate its race. A botanist notices that the bee flying with the pollen of a male flower to a pistil fertilizes the latter, and sees in this the purpose of the bee’s existence. Another, observing the migration of plants, notices that the bee helps in this work, and may say that in this lies the purpose of the bee. But the ultimate purpose of the bee is not exhausted by the first, the second, or any of the processes the human mind can discern. The higher the human intellect rises in the discovery of these purposes, the more obvious it becomes, that the ultimate purpose is beyond our comprehension.

cases.sentence: Человеку доступно только наблюдение над соответственностью жизни пчелы с ___ жизни.
cases.explain: «другими явлениями» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: All that is accessible to man is the relation of the life of the bee to other manifestations of life. And so it is with the purpose of historic characters and nations.

cases.sentence: То же нужно сказать о целях ___ и народов.
